{"people":[{"name":"Priya","role":"account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"PMM","role":"product marketer (interviewer)","side":"us"},{"name":"Daniel","role":"VP of Engineering, final decision-maker who signed","side":"customer"},{"name":"CFO (unnamed)","role":"CFO, joined one call for ten minutes","side":"customer"},{"name":"Unnamed engineer (she)","role":"customer engineer who built the weekend prototype","side":"customer"},{"name":"Unnamed engineer at kickoff","role":"Daniel's engineer, spoke at kickoff","side":"customer"},{"name":"Incumbent account manager (unnamed)","role":"competitor's account manager, changed three times in two years","side":"competitor"},{"name":"Braintree","role":"competitor the customer reportedly spoke with mid-evaluation","side":"competitor"}],
"competitors":["Braintree"],
"incumbent":null,
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"Expansion. They were launching Canada, then the UK, and sitters have to get paid locally.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Trigger: international expansion requiring local sitter payouts."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"a haunted house.","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (VP Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","language"],"note":"Customer's own description of their payments code."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"Two engineers more or less full-time just keeping sitter payments working.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Engineering cost of existing payments; 'more or less' is approximate."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"There was also a roadmap item, faster pay for sitters, that had been pushed three quarters in a row.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Faster sitter pay roadmap item repeatedly delayed."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"Daniel. He signed.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","outcome"],"note":"Daniel named as decider and signer."},
{"id":"E6","turn":4,"excerpt":"The CFO joined one call for ten minutes, asked one question, ","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"CFO involvement was minimal."},
{"id":"E7","turn":4,"excerpt":"does this change when sitters get paid?","label":"quote","speaker":"CFO","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","language"],"note":"CFO's only question concerned sitter payment timing."},
{"id":"E8","turn":4,"excerpt":"this is an engineering decision, finance will sign what I bring them.","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (VP Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Daniel stated early that engineering owned the decision."},
{"id":"E9","turn":6,"excerpt":"Their account manager had changed three times in two years.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Incumbent service complaint relayed by rep."},
{"id":"E10","turn":6,"excerpt":"I've stopped learning their names.","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (VP Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","language"],"note":"Daniel's own words on incumbent account churn."},
{"id":"E11","turn":6,"excerpt":"A lot of pet owners pay with PayPal and Venmo, and they were nervous about what happens to those buttons.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","gaps"],"note":"Customer concern about PayPal/Venmo continuity."},
{"id":"E12","turn":8,"excerpt":"They had a call with Braintree in the middle of the evaluation. I know because the questions changed.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Braintree call is inferred from changed questions, not directly observed."},
{"id":"E13","turn":8,"excerpt":"It went from \"how fast can we build this\" to \"what do we lose.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","gaps"],"note":"Observed shift in customer questions mid-evaluation."},
{"id":"E14","turn":8,"excerpt":"I assume Braintree told them they'd lose things. I don't know that. That's me guessing.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Rep explicitly flags guess about competitor messaging."},
{"id":"E15","turn":8,"excerpt":"Do we lose PayPal, do we lose Venmo, what happens to the saved cards.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":true,"topics":["gaps","competitor"],"note":"Customer's later questions: PayPal, Venmo, saved cards; rep's rendering, not verbatim."},
{"id":"E16","turn":10,"excerpt":"Reaction: the docs and the sandbox.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Docs and sandbox drew reaction."},
{"id":"E17","turn":10,"excerpt":"One of their engineers, on her own time, built a working sitter payment flow over a weekend and showed it at Monday standup.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decided"],"note":"Customer engineer self-built prototype using our product."},
{"id":"E18","turn":10,"excerpt":"I didn't even know until Daniel told me.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decided"],"note":"Rep unaware of prototype until told; not driven by rep."},
{"id":"E19","turn":10,"excerpt":"And the marketplace piece. Onboarding sitters, the identity checks, paying out in local currency.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Marketplace features also drew reaction."},
{"id":"E20","turn":10,"excerpt":"Silence: the acceptance-rate slide.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Acceptance-rate slide got no reaction."},
{"id":"E21","turn":10,"excerpt":"our average booking is 38 dollars, I'm not losing sleep over auth rates.","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (VP Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Why acceptance-rate pitch fell flat: low booking value."},
{"id":"E22","turn":12,"excerpt":"The weekend prototype. Before that it was a bake-off. After that Daniel stopped saying \"if.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Prototype was the turning point from bake-off to 'when'."},
{"id":"E23","turn":14,"excerpt":"Nothing, really. It was a clean one.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Claims no gaps; later contradicted by PayPal/Venmo and saved-card admissions."},
{"id":"E24","turn":16,"excerpt":"We kind of danced around it. We said they could keep offering PayPal and we'd work through the details in implementation.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"PayPal concern deferred to implementation, no concrete answer."},
{"id":"E25","turn":16,"excerpt":"I didn't have a crisp answer on Venmo in the room, and I still don't.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Venmo question unanswered at signing and still open."},
{"id":"E26","turn":16,"excerpt":"They decided it was a risk they'd take.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"Rep's characterization; no customer words given."},
{"id":"E27","turn":18,"excerpt":"We walked them through moving saved cards over so nobody has to re-enter anything. But it was a doc and a conversation.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Saved-card migration covered only by doc and conversation, no proof."},
{"id":"E28","turn":18,"excerpt":"who's done this at our size without losing cards?","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (VP Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Daniel asked for a reference/proof of migration at scale."},
{"id":"E29","turn":18,"excerpt":"I said I'd get back to him. I didn't.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Rep never followed up on Daniel's reference question."},
{"id":"E30","turn":20,"excerpt":"Once, in the kickoff.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","outcome"],"note":"Saved-card concern resurfaced once at kickoff, post-signature."},
{"id":"E31","turn":20,"excerpt":"we'll find out.","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel's engineer","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Customer engineer's response; concern still open at kickoff."},
{"id":"E32","turn":22,"excerpt":"Payments shouldn't be a team,","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (VP Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","trigger"],"note":"Daniel said this repeatedly."},
{"id":"E33","turn":22,"excerpt":"We want to stop babysitting this.","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (VP Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","trigger"],"note":"Customer's phrasing of desired outcome."},
{"id":"E34","turn":22,"excerpt":"On the sitter side it's \"paid by Friday.\" The whole promise to sitters is paid by Friday.","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer's sitter-facing promise is 'paid by Friday'."},
{"id":"E35","turn":22,"excerpt":"Nobody there says \"marketplace.\" They say \"the app.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer says 'the app', not 'marketplace'."},
{"id":"E36","turn":22,"excerpt":"And nobody says \"payouts.\" They say \"sitter pay.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer says 'sitter pay', not 'payouts'."},
{"id":"E37","turn":24,"excerpt":"Only that I barely sold this. Their engineer did.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Priya","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","message"],"note":"Rep's view that the customer's engineer drove the win."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E23","E24","E25"],"what":"Rep said there was nothing they couldn't show and 'a clean one', then admitted dancing around PayPal and having no crisp Venmo answer."},
{"evidence":["E23","E27","E28","E29"],"what":"Rep said 'clean one', yet the saved-card proof request from Daniel went unanswered after she promised to get back to him."},
{"evidence":["E12","E14"],"what":"Rep says she 'knows' of the Braintree call because questions changed, then admits she doesn't know what Braintree told them and is guessing."},
{"evidence":["E5","E8","E37"],"what":"Daniel is the named decider and signer, but rep says their engineer sold it, suggesting influence beyond Daniel."},
{"evidence":["E26","E15","E30"],"what":"Rep says customer 'decided it was a risk they'd take', but PayPal/Venmo/saved-card concerns were still open at kickoff."}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"What did they ask for that we couldn't show?","turn":14,"what":"Answered 'Nothing, really. It was a clean one.' then admitted PayPal/Venmo and saved-card gaps when pressed."},
{"question":"Earlier you said they were nervous about the PayPal and Venmo buttons. What did we show them on that?","turn":16,"what":"Opened with a pause and 'danced around it'; gave no concrete demonstration or answer."}
],
"skipped":[],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"the app","ours":"marketplace","evidence":["E35"]},
{"theirs":"sitter pay","ours":"payouts","evidence":["E36"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E5"],"what":"Won: Daniel signed."},
{"evidence":["E30","E31"],"what":"Kickoff occurred, confirming the deal closed and moved to implementation."},
{"evidence":["E22","E17"],"what":"Deal tipped from bake-off to 'when' after the customer engineer's weekend prototype."},
{"evidence":["E25","E26","E30"],"what":"Venmo and saved-card concerns remained unresolved at signing and kickoff; transcript does not say whether only part of the business moved."}
]}
